execution_envelope.distinction: The 600-second bounded execution turn is not the 900-second P0 acceptance window.

startup_measurement.rule: Preserve raw historical samples; classify current v5.5 generation prospectively only from observed boundaries. Invocation metadata alone is not BOOT_STARTED or first useful work.

active_retest.purpose: Verify direct same-wake work cadence: verified provisional schedule trace, one trace per durably persisted bounded substantive unit, continued work after each trace, and final exact END+60 due trace.
active_retest.success_signal: Normal >=600s CONTINUE wake shows verified provisional schedule trace; multiple genuine durably persisted bounded-unit traces; no trace-induced early close; SAME MAIN exact END+60 close trace; no duplicate substantive overlap.
active_retest.failure_signal: Any completion trace without durable unit duration/work evidence, any trace treated as a close boundary, or failure to continue safe authorized work before 600s.

latest_diagnosis.evidence: The v5.5 wake has durable startup receipts and multiple bounded material changes; enforcement mirrors discovered stale 480s, +780s, and Watchdog observability text and are being reconciled forward.
latest_diagnosis.implication: Continue using evidence-bound traces to expose real cadence; do not infer useful work from elapsed time or prose alone.

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Binding each progress message to durable unit completion evidence will make premature return and idle gaps directly observable without changing scheduler authority.
next_corrective_experiment.success_signal: Same-wake trace sequence demonstrates schedule arm -> multiple durably evidenced units -> exact END+60 close.
